title: Case: Bookcase delivery moved to a timed afternoon slot, then a carrier service notice arrives
context: A recipient wanted a timed afternoon slot instead of an all-day booking for a bookcase. Foxhallow owns bookings and contacts recipients about any change to them.
initial_request: SERVICE NOTICE SN-2551, sent to all partner desks. Flooding on the Calder causeway: deliveries and collections from Calderby depot and Ostmoor depot are suspended on 2027-03-17 and 2027-03-18. All other depots, including Wrenfold, Harrowgate and Sedge Lane, are operating normally with no change to booked windows. Foxhallow is contacting the recipients of affected shipments directly with new dates. Desks do not need to contact customers or reply to this notice. Next notice 2027-03-18 06:00 UTC, or sooner if the position changes.

events.body: Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Monday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
My parcel DL-10305 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
I've got an all-day delivery on Thursday for the bookcase (TG-6359). Can't sit in the whole day, I can do after 2. Is there an afternoon slot and does it cost anything?

Please quote any timed afternoon windows for DL-5676 on 2027-03-18, from 14:00 UTC onwards, with the total upgrade charge. The recipient is Quillon Blackwood. Please do not change the booking until he accepts.
Route plan for depot BR-8 published for Wednesday. 28 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
I have asked Foxhallow at Fallowmere Arc what afternoon windows they have on Thursday and what they cost. Only they can quote and change the booking; they will reply to you and copy me.

events.to: Quillon Blackwood, recipient; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body:
DL-5676 is at Wrenfold depot. We can offer 2027-03-18, 14:00–16:00 UTC, total upgrade charge GBP 5.00. Reply in this thread to accept by 17:00 UTC today.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-253.txt

events.to: Foxhallow, Fallowmere Arc Logistics; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Yes please, 2 to 4 and the £5 is fine.

events.to: Quillon Blackwood, recipient; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Confirmed: DL-5676 is booked for 2027-03-18, 14:00–16:00 UTC from Wrenfold depot, GBP 5.00 upgrade accepted. The all-day booking is removed. Delivery itself is still to come.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
My parcel DL-36483 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

must: Takes no action and sends no message to anyone.
Checks the notice against the shipment: DL-5676 is at Wrenfold depot, which the notice lists as operating normally, so the booked 2027-03-18, 14:00–16:00 UTC window is not affected.
Records what is in hand: Foxhallow confirmed the booking and the recipient acknowledged it; Foxhallow contacts recipients of affected shipments itself.
Notes that the desk next needs to look at the next notice, due 2027-03-18 06:00 UTC, in case Wrenfold is added.
must_not: Warns the recipient that his delivery may be delayed or disrupted by the flooding.
Tells the recipient his delivery is unaffected and will arrive in the 14:00–16:00 window as a promise from the desk.
Asks Foxhallow to confirm or re-confirm DL-5676, or to rebook it.
Treats label-scan-253.txt as evidence about DL-5676: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-36137)
Tells anyone that DL-5676 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-253.txt
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments

rationale: Rule-made from gen-1110: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. label-scan-253.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-36137); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. 5 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
